Detailed Descriptive.Geographic coverage: Cook County without City of Chicago
Detailed Descriptive.Ordinance Text: A temporary reprocessing activities permit shall be required for the reprocessing, storage, transport and/or final usage of materials generated from construction and/or demolition.

columns.description: name of the site where temporary reprocessing activity is taking place

columns.description: type of facility or site where temporary reprocessing activity is taking place

columns.name: Permit Expiration Date
columns.description: date that temporary reprocessing activity permit expires

columns.name: Anticipated Start Date
columns.description: expected start date of temporary reprocessing activity

columns.name: Anticipated End Date
columns.description: expected end date of temporary reprocessing activity

columns.name: Address
columns.description: address of site where temporary reprocessing activity is taking place

columns.name: City
columns.description: city where temporary reprocessing activity is taking place

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: zip code where temporary reprocessing activity is taking place

columns.name: Anticipated Work Days

columns.name: Operator Organization Name
